hooks.name: Fix Upload Permissions
hooks.description: Automatically fix file permissions after upload to prevent 403 Forbidden errors

action.command: cd /var/www/myserver-portofolio && chmod -R 755 storage/app/public && find storage/app/public -type f -exec chmod 644 {} \; && chown -R root:root storage/app/public 2>/dev/null && chmod -R 755 public/storage && find public/storage -type f -exec chmod 644 {} \; && chown -R root:root public/storage 2>/dev/null
